findings: The book says resonance occurs at whole-number multiples of the natural frequency; clarified in a warning that this applies to strings and air columns.

The book prints 'reactor scale' for the 2005 earthquake (Richter scale) and 3-30 GHz for microwave ovens (household ovens use about 2.45 GHz); both noted. The book prints no answers; the lesson's answers were derived for it and need the second-person review.
